environment.details: Synthetic dual-stack bootstrap fixture whose IPv6 path to the endpoint is dead; no real network or user data.

ground_truth.statement: The synthetic endpoint answers over IPv4 and never over IPv6, while general egress works in both families.

verification.details: The fixture directly controls every typed probe observation.

provenance.summary: Generated from typed in-memory observations solely to bootstrap the replay harness.

notes: Exercises per-family reachability, the selected address, and per-address attempts, which is the evidence the address-family counterfactual rests on.
